short_description: Standalone evolutionary ecosystem research: grow ecology from landscape/history without player or biome species tables, then later transfer and continue the same ecology inside the world simulator.
purpose: Build a reusable autonomous evolutionary ecology mini-project that evolves plant and later multi-trophic ecosystems from causal environment/resource/competition/history rules, exports portable spatial ecology state, and eventually feeds World Generation/local/background simulation without duplicate ecology truth.
progress_note: CAL1-E is accepted on exact Windows Godot 4.7.1 double with aggregate 6214b8348b16acd005979c3e8ea88eca202acac0ffe835fc899cef27fbe50814. Its 192-row / 24-context combined matrix preserved CAL1-D, kept all sparse neighbour interactions at zero, activated all dense rows, and retained multi-member Pareto fronts in every context with two distinct Pareto signatures. CAL1-F is now the only executable checkpoint. It may introduce an explicit CAL1-F calibration profile and perturbation sweeps, but must not modify accepted A-E sources or tune toward a preferred strategy.
next_stage: Execute CAL1-F robustness across deterministic phenotype seeds, environment/density/disturbance sweeps, explicit mechanism-magnitude perturbations and strategy-pool composition changes. Require restart determinism and report fragility rather than hiding it. If accepted, close CAL1 and move to ECO.EVO1 Plant World Proof.

ownership_claims.scope: organism/lineage ecological semantics, causal resource economics, population/cohort ecological state meaning, dispersal/recruitment/succession/disturbance/biogeography, trophic interaction research semantics, EcologyArchive meaning and derived ecology projection requirements
